position: “大盘蓝筹”企业，国民经济的“压舱石”。主要服务于规模巨大、经营稳定、在行业中处于领先地位的成熟型企业。这些企业通常是各行业的龙头，具有强大的盈利能力和抗风险能力。
position2: "Large-cap blue-chip" enterprises, the "ballast stones" of the national economy. Primarily serving mature enterprises with large scale, stable operations, and a leading position in their industries. These enterprises are usually leaders in various sectors, boasting strong profitability and risk resistance capabilities.
position3: 「大盤藍籌」企業，國民經濟的「壓艙石」。主要服務於規模龐大、經營穩定、在產業中處於領先地位的成熟型企業。這些企業通常是各行各業的龍頭，具備強大的獲利能力與抗風險能力。
name: 上交所主板
name2: Main Board of the Shanghai Stock Exchange（SSE Main Board）
creator: 99ea7655-00a2-4bda-b23c-19ade37ea574

position: “硬科技”企业，中国科技创新的“主战场”。面向世界科技前沿、面向经济主战场、面向国家重大需求，主要服务于符合国家战略、突破关键核心技术、市场认可度高的科技创新企业。
position2: "Hard technology" enterprises, the "main battlefield" of China's technological innovation. Oriented towards the world's cutting-edge science and technology, the main economic battlefield, and national major needs, they mainly serve technological innovation enterprises that conform to national strategies, break through key core technologies, and enjoy high market recognition.
position3: 「硬科技」企業，中國科技創新的「主戰場」。面向世界科技前沿、面向經濟主戰場、面向國家重大需求，主要服務於符合國家戰略、突破關鍵核心技術、市場認可度高的科技創新企業。
name: 科创板
creator: 99ea7655-00a2-4bda-b23c-19ade37ea574

position: “成熟型成长企业”，支持企业做优做强。主要服务于经营相对成熟、具备一定规模、在行业内具有较强竞争力的成长型企业。它与原“中小板”合并后，进一步拓宽了对成长型企业的覆盖面。
position2: "Mature growing enterprises," supporting enterprises to become better and stronger. Primarily serving growing enterprises with relatively mature operations, a certain scale, and strong competitiveness in their industries. After merging with the former SME Board, it has further expanded the coverage of growing enterprises.
position3: 「成熟型成長企業」，支持企業做優做強。主要服務於經營相對成熟、具備一定規模、在產業內具有較強競爭力的成長型企業。其與原「中小板」合併後，進一步拓寬了對成長型企業的覆蓋面。
name: 深交所主板
name2: Main Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange（SZSE Main Board）
creator: 99ea7655-00a2-4bda-b23c-19ade37ea574

position: “三创四新”的成长型创新创业企业。主要服务于成长型创新创业企业，支持传统产业与新技术、新产业、新业态、新模式的深度融合。
position2: Growing innovative and entrepreneurial enterprises featuring "Three Creations and Four Innovations." Primarily serving growing innovative and entrepreneurial enterprises, supporting the in-depth integration of traditional industries with new technologies, new industries, new formats, and new models.
position3: 具備「三創四新」特質的成長型創新創業企業。主要服務於成長型創新創業企業，支持傳統產業與新技術、新產業、新業態、新模式的深度融合。
name: 创业板
creator: 99ea7655-00a2-4bda-b23c-19ade37ea574

position: “创新型中小企业”，打造“专精特新”小巨人的主阵地。精准服务于创新型中小企业，特别是那些专注于细分市场、创新能力强、成长性好、具有专业化、精细化、特色化、新颖化特征的“专精特新”企业。
position2: "Innovative small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs)," the main position for fostering "Professional, Refined, Specialized, and Innovative" little giants. Precisely serving innovative SMEs, especially those "Professional, Refined, Specialized, and Innovative" enterprises that focus on niche markets, possess strong innovation capabilities, exhibit good growth potential, and demonstrate professionalization, refinement, specialization, and novelty.
position3: 「創新型中小企業」，打造「專精特新」小巨人的主陣地。精準服務於創新型中小企業，尤其聚焦於深耕細分市場、創新能力強、成長性佳、具備專業化、精細化、特色化、新颖化特徵的「專精特新」企業。
name: 北交所
creator: 99ea7655-00a2-4bda-b23c-19ade37ea574
